summary: The purchase entry process is used to record the acquisition of new inventory items from external vendors. This includes detailing who the purchase was made from, the payment method, the items purchased, their quantities, and allows for the upload of supporting documents.
steps: Enter details about the vendor from whom the items were purchased.
Enter details of the purchased items and their respective quantities.
Optionally, upload purchase documents (e.g., invoices, receipts).
business_rules: This entry records the acquisition of new inventory into the system.
All relevant details of the purchase, including vendor and payment, should be accurately captured.
important_notes: A purchase entry is more comprehensive than just a purchase bill; it captures detailed transaction information and allows for document uploads.
questions: How do I record new inventory purchases in the system?
What details are included in a purchase entry?
Can I upload purchase bills to the system?
How do I track purchases from different vendors?
